findings.title: Unrelated re-encoding of an existing fixture string
findings.detail:
The existing mr update fixture's stdout changed from a literal '✓' to the escape '\u2713'. The JSON value is the same, so this is churn outside the slice's scope, probably from re-serialising the file.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Keep the original literal character when appending fixtures.
